extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a Guildford estate worth about £550,000 (mainly the deceased's home) asks for £72,000 to cover professional fees and inheritance tax due by 16 October while the property is sold.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding the Guildford estate. We have noted the request for £72,000 against an estate of approximately £550,000, and the 16 October tax date. To take this further we would need the grant of probate or application status, a breakdown of estate assets and liabilities, confirmation of the executors' details, the property's valuation and marketing position, and details of any existing charges on the property. We will review the information and come back to you with next steps; nothing in this message should be taken as an offer or an indication of terms.
